intake.processDescription: Synthetic website leads arrive through a form and are copied manually into HubSpot; duplicates are sometimes created.

sources.content: Validate form webhooks and use an idempotency key before CRM writes.

intake.processDescription: Synthetic support emails are manually triaged into a ticket queue and staff need a proposed routing process.

sources.content: Record failed intake and retry only idempotent operations with bounded attempts.

intake.processDescription: A synthetic inventory spreadsheet needs to be checked against a demo database every night and discrepancies should become a reviewable report.

sources.content: Confirm the source of truth and data ownership before designing an integration.

intake.processDescription: An operator manually starts each synthetic vendor review after checking documents; the system should prepare a draft but never approve it itself.

sources.content: A named reviewer must explicitly approve any external record or message action.

intake.processDescription: The synthetic team wants less manual work but has not identified which system starts the process or which data should be used.

sources.content: Identify trigger, source system, data owner and success criteria before proposing an implementation.

intake.processDescription: Synthetic leads from a web form should enter a CRM, but the selected CRM has no confirmed API or webhook capability.

sources.content: Do not assume an API exists; confirm authentication, scopes and data ownership first.
